readmeSignals.title: π RuView
readmeSignals.summary: Turn ordinary WiFi into a spatial intelligence / sensing system. Detect people, measure breathing and heart rate, track movement, and monitor rooms — through walls, in the dark, with no cameras or wearables. Just physics. Works natively with the four major smart-home ecosystems: docs/integrations/home-assistant.md via the HA-DISCO MQTT publisher, docs/user-guide-apple-homepod.md as a discoverable HAP-1.1 bridge, docs/integrations/home-assistant.md + docs/integrations/home-assistant.md via the same HA bridge or a docs/adr/ADR-122-bfld-ruview-ha-matter-exposure.md endpoint. Siri, Google Assistant, and Alexa can voice presence and vitals by room with zero custom skills.
headings: π RuView is a WiFi sensing platform that turns radio signals into spatial intelligence.
